summary.summary: Raven called Jim back to confirm scheduling constraints for starting his roof installation, asking if there were any days in the next few weeks that would not work. Jim clarified he was thinking in a 4-to-6-week window and said there should be no conflicts, noting they had considered taking a vacation but may postpone it until the roofing work is completed. Raven acknowledged the update and said she would update the notes, and the call ended politely with thanks.
key_points: Customer rep (Raven) asked Jim if there were any days in the next couple of weeks that would not work for starting the roof installation.
Jim clarified the timeframe as the next 4 to 6 weeks and said there should be no scheduling conflicts.
Jim mentioned they were thinking about taking a vacation but might postpone it until after the roof installation is completed; Raven said she would update that information.
action_items: Update the project notes/schedule to reflect that Jim has no blackout dates in the next 4–6 weeks and may postpone vacation until after completion.
next_steps: Proceed with planning the roof installation start within the next 4–6 weeks since no conflicts were reported.
Confirm the final installation start date with Jim when the schedule is set.
